w8.title: Your AI agents have audit logs. Can you reconstruct their decisions?
w8.summary: The moment arrives after the damage. An agent has cancelled a supplier contract, approved a refund it should have declined or moved a customer record somewhere it should never have gone. Someone senior asks a simple question. Why did it do that? The engineering team opens the logs. There are thousands of lines. Every call is timestamped. Every tool invocation is recorded. And nobody in the room can say why the agent chose what it chose. This pattern is becoming familiar. It will become more so.
